remarks:
Discover the endless possibilities at 13081 Main Rd, Newstead, NY 14001!  This unique property offers a rare combination of industrial-scale storage and versatile agricultural opportunity, making it ideal for investors, farmers, or future development.
The owner has recently reconfigured the parcel boundaries, and an updated survey confirms the actual lot size is 53.94 acres. 
Features a substantial, approximately 6,000 sqft. barn/warehouse, perfect for storage, a workshop, equipment, or business operations. Expansive, open land ready for agricultural use. The back acreage includes a greenhouse structure and fertile soil currently utilized for crops like chives and garlic scapes. Includes a dedicated white outbuilding specially designed and equipped for small animal husbandry.The adjacent properties at 13123 Main Rd and 13151 Main Rd are also currently available for sale.
Updated survey on file. Don't miss it!
